title: Sara Muñoz Madrid — 'La solución no es tener mejores intenciones. Es tener mejor estructura.' (The solution isn't better intentions — it's better structure.)
summary: Sara Muñoz Madrid recaps the María José Echeverri Colombia conversation with Eric: takes away the rocket analogy — a barely-perceptible degree of deviation at liftoff, sustained over time, ends up on a completely different planet. That's how companies drift. The typical founder answer of 'I'll stay vigilant and mitigate risk when it happens' isn't enough because short-term financial pressure is stronger than any individual's willpower. Solution: better structure, not better intentions.
blockquote: Dio un ejemplo simple. Un cohete rumbo a la Luna. Un grado de desvío en el despegue casi imperceptible. Pero ese error mínimo, sostenido en el tiempo, termina en un planeta completamente distinto.
